name: Trickplayer
description: Plex/Jellyfin player as synced thumbnails + subs

permissions.name: network
permissions.desc: Connects to Plex to sign in, and to your own Plex or Jellyfin server (plex.direct or tailscale ts.net) to download trick-play frames and subtitles.

notes: Pictures reach the glasses about twice as fast. The way each frame is shaded changed after timing five encodings over Bluetooth on real hardware — the one that was default turned out to be the slowest of them.
The picture may look slightly different because of it. Settings now has Texture and Grey levels, both switchable while something is playing, so you can pick what suits you.
When the link slows, the picture degrades more gracefully: it changes shading before it starts throwing away grey levels, and only reduces size as a last resort.
